verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own receipt matching: users email or upload receipts and Mercury auto-attaches them to the right card transaction. It also mentions AI-powered automations for syncing to QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite, transaction categories, and an official receipt-upload agent skill. However, the user still has to forward or upload each receipt, and automatic coding at the point of card use is only vaguely implied. Missing for 10: automatic receipt capture triggered by the card swipe without user action, explicit documentation of AI auto-categorization/coding of card transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
